borrow_or_financing: none (long-only SVXY/SPY/SHY/SMH/QQQ, no leverage held directly beyond SVXY's own built-in -0.5x/-1x structure, no shorting)
cost_model: sum(abs(delta_weight)) * slippage_bps, charged on the execution session (next session open after the close signal)
k2_control_cost_model: the vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control pays no rebalancing cost (conservative in the control's favor, matching every prior batch-screening round's convention)
note_vs_source: The QuantConnect replication's own convention (market-on-close orders, skip trade unless target weight changes sign or moves >=2%) is NOT applied here -- this project's frozen contract (close-signal -> next-session-open fill, 10bp/20bp per side, every signal day rebalanced) is applied unedited, identical to every other screen_lane batch. This means our version trades more often (no 2% no-trade band) than the source's own live-implementation convention; reported as a methodology difference in report.md's QuantConnect reconciliation, not adjusted for.
